statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); model_id=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.id'); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); transcript=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.transcript_path'); cost=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cost.total_cost_usd // 0'); git_branch=$(cd "$cwd" 2>/dev/null && git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo ''); case "$model_id" in *haiku*) window=200000 ;; *) window=1000000 ;; esac; used=$(tail -r "$transcript" 2>/dev/null | jq -rc 'select(.message.usage and (.isSidechain != true)) | .message.usage | (.input_tokens + (.cache_read_input_tokens // 0) + (.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0))' 2>/dev/null | head -1); used=${used:-0}; pct=$(( used * 100 / window )); cost_fmt=$(printf '$%.2f' "$cost"); dir=$(basename "$cwd"); if [ -n "$git_branch" ]; then printf "%s in %s on %s    %s    %d%%" "$model" "$dir" "$git_branch" "$cost_fmt" "$pct"; else printf "%s in %s    %s    %d%%" "$model" "$dir" "$cost_fmt" "$pct"; fi
